photos.c: Our photograph shows Belgrave's winning South of Thames Junior team at Epsom Downs on 7th November 1928. They are (left to right), ARTHUR ALLUM (4th), BILL RICE (13th), BILL MITCHELL (2nd), and ARTHUR PENNY (3rd)
